claim: frozen cascade keeps 99% of comparator accuracy
found_value: Confirmed as a rounded headline figure in the Conclusion ('keep 99% of GPT-6's accuracy at 57% of its fee'). The precise frozen two-order policy (GPT-6 Astra fallback, tau=0.9, Table 3) retains 92.5/93.1 = 99.36% of GPT-6 Astra's standalone accuracy at 56.8% of its fee (62.2% under the conservative usage bound), accepting 53.7% of the 510 extension pairs. Threshold was chosen on 96 pilot selection pairs before the extension/model-expansion inference, per Section 3 'What was frozen and when' and Section 7 'Frozen two-order policies', to avoid leakage into the evaluated extension set.
excerpt: Because JEV’s confidence marks where its errors lie, the escalation can be automatic: accept when confident, escalate when unsure, and keep 99% of GPT-6’s accuracy at 57% of its fee.
location: Section 8 Conclusion; Table 3 (GPT-6 Astra row, tau=0.90); Section 7 'Frozen two-order policies'
